versions.changelog:
memory-fortress-free v1.0.0

- Initial release of "记忆堡垒(免费版)", an AI Agent six-layer memory system.
- Solves context loss, decision forgetting, and repeated mistakes by combining multiple verified memory strategies.
- WAL (Write-Ahead Log) protocol ensures memory persistence against crashes and interruptions.
- Free version supports core three layers: 热内存 (SESSION-STATE.md), 冷存储 (Git-Notes), and 策展归档 (MEMORY.md + logs).
- Provides setup instructions, usage scenarios, memory hygiene practices, and troubleshooting guidance.
